title: Where the weights came from
note: text = subtitles; say = spelled for the voice. Numbers from brain3d/trace.json, films/qkv_data.json, experiments/logs.

blocks.text: Every bet came from the weights: 494 million numbers inside the model. Where did they come from?
blocks.say: Every bet came from the weights: four hundred and ninety-four million numbers inside the model. Where did they come from?

blocks.text: At the start, they are random. Our tiny GPT, trained on Northbridge's own documents, shows it. Before training, it writes noise.
blocks.say: At the start, they are random. Our tiny GPT, trained on Northbridge's own documents, shows it. Before training, it writes noise.

blocks.text: Training is the same game, played over and over: guess the next character, measure the error, nudge every weight a little. The loss falls from 4.6 to 0.23 in 1,500 steps.
blocks.say: Training is the same game, played over and over: guess the next character, measure the error, nudge every weight a little. The loss falls from four point six to zero point two three in fifteen hundred steps.

blocks.text: Afterwards it writes perfect Northbridge stock lines. BAT-500 in Manchester stores: 2,400 on hand. Well formed, and invented. The real figure, 5,400, was in its training text three times.
blocks.say: Afterwards it writes perfect Northbridge stock lines. BAT five hundred in Manchester stores: two thousand four hundred on hand. Well formed, and invented. The real figure, five thousand four hundred, was in its training text three times.

blocks.text: Qwen went through the same steps at vast scale: up to 18 trillion tokens of pretraining, over a million instruction examples, then preference tuning. Its weights were frozen at its release, on 19 September 2024. Emma asked on 26 October 2026.
blocks.say: Qwen went through the same steps at vast scale: up to eighteen trillion tokens of pretraining, over a million instruction examples, then preference tuning. Its weights were frozen at its release, on the nineteenth of September, twenty twenty-four. Emma asked on the twenty-sixth of October, twenty twenty-six.
